thread:
emily_p: Hey team — need quick guidance. Contractor from OptiTrace needs read access to k8s audit logs & our LLM trace exports to debug a prompt routing bug. They only need 48h and should NOT see raw prompts/PII. Can we do least-privileged access to a redacted view? @mike_sec @sre_oncall_jordan

mike_sec: short answer: yes, but don’t give org/project Viewer. Create an ephemeral role bound to a redacted dataset or log sink. Prefer JIT access (4–48h) with session recording + approval.

sre_oncall_jordan: +1. Two practical options: (1) create a redacted BigQuery dataset (prod_redacted_traces) with prompts scrubbed and grant roles/bigquery.dataViewer for that dataset only, OR (2) grant logs access to a log-viewer sink (logs:viewer) scoped to the k8s namespace resource via a log exclusion/sink. Both ephemeral.

emily_p: good, which is less setup overhead? we need something by EOD for customer demo tomorrow.

mike_sec: fastest = redacted BigQuery export. Tamir, can you produce a scrubbed export with the same schema but prompt_text replaced with <REDACTED> or hashed id? then we grant contractor dataset-level access for 48h. Also: require SSO login + access request ticket.

tamir_engineer: I can run a one-off export now. Will replace prompt_text with SHA256(hash_id) and keep trace_id/time/service. ETA 2h. I’ll push to prod_redacted_traces.{events_YYYYMMDD}.

anna_privacy: add privacy checklist: (1) no raw prompt backups in the export, (2) confirm hashes are irreversible for small inputs (use salt), (3) update access ticket with purpose + data retention window, (4) NDA signed for external contractor.

emily_p: noted. Mike — for IAM role names and exact grant steps can you paste the minimal commands/permissions we should use?

mike_sec: sure — minimal plan: create a custom role scoped to the dataset with these permissions: ["bigquery.datasets.get","bigquery.tables.get","bigquery.tables.list","bigquery.tables.getData"]. Then grant the contractor principal that custom role on the dataset resource for 48h via our JIT system. If you need CLI snippets:

```
# create custom role (org-scoped)
gcloud iam roles create RedactedBQViewer --organization=$ORG_ID \
  --title="Redacted BQ Viewer" --permissions="bigquery.datasets.get,bigquery.tables.get,bigquery.tables.list,bigquery.tables.getData"

# grant role on dataset
# uses our access-request service to attach TTL
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding $PROJECT_ID \
  --member='user:contractor@optitrace.com' --role='roles/org.RedactedBQViewer' 
```

mike_sec: If you cannot use gcloud org roles, fallback: grant roles/bigquery.dataViewer at dataset level (dataset-level binding) via the console and set expiration in our Access Requests UI. Always require MFA and session capture.

deploy-bot: Role request created: ticket #AR-4921 by emily_p — awaiting sec & privacy approval.

emily_p: perfect. I’ll open the NDA and confirm the export from Tamir. If we hit any hiccups I’ll ping here. Thanks! :thumbsup:
